observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Street intersection or town square in Port Maria, St Mary, Jamaica, during daytime with traffic, onlookers, and buildings visible.
observation.dancers: A group of multiple adults and youths in costume, mixed genders, performing solo or dispersed across the street space.
observation.formation_and_space: Scattered formation on a paved street and gas station forecourt, individuals moving individually or in loose groups around traffic.
observation.posture: Hunched torso, knees bent in a low stance, weight shifted low with a pronounced crouch or bounce.
observation.footwork: Stepping and hopping on alternate feet, kicking legs out low to the side or front in sync with drumbeats, maintaining a constant low bounce.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held out to the sides or swinging loosely, often holding a walking stick or staff in one hand.
observation.hips_and_torso: Hips sway and shift with the low-crouched bounce; torso angled forward with slight shaking or jerking motions.
observation.partnering: None; dancers perform individually without physical contact.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low level maintained throughout due to bent knees and crouching posture; occasional small hops and shuffling turns.
observation.costume_and_props: Elaborate costumes including masks (such as skull masks and horned masks), fringed or textured full-body garments in various colors (green, white, black, patterned), and wooden walking sticks held in hand.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact weight transfer details and subtle footwork variations are obscured by camera movement, distance, and low-resolution video framing.

signature_moments.what: Dancer in skull mask and patterned dress crouching low with bent knees, hopping side to side while leaning on a wooden staff.
Dancer in white fringed costume moving forward in a low, bouncy hop, swinging arms and holding a staff.
Multiple costumed dancers moving around each other in the street with low knee-bent bouncing steps and sticks in hand.
